title: Set up credit card
summary: Get a corporate card for company spend — compare issuers, apply online, and sync transactions into the books.

parts.title: Compare card providers
parts.guidance: Compare card products against intended cardholders, spending categories, currencies, repayment needs and approval controls. Examine fees, eligibility, credit or deposit requirements, liability and accounting exports in the current terms. Understand the cash implications and any personal guarantee before selecting a product; unresolved financing commitments belong with the company officer who can accept them.

parts.title: Apply for the corporate card online
parts.guidance: Apply with verified company, ownership and financial information. The officer authorized to accept the card agreement reviews the offered limit, repayment terms, fees and any guarantee or collateral commitment before submitting. If approved, establish administrators and spending controls before issuing cards, and resolve any conditions affecting the account’s use.

parts.title: Sync card transactions into the books
parts.guidance: Connect the card account to the correct accounting entity through the authorized administrator. Choose an import date and match existing transactions to prevent duplicates. Map balances, repayments, fees and receipts, then reconcile a statement end to end. Assign responsibility for missing receipts and failed syncs so the connection supports ongoing bookkeeping.

metadata.supportReason: Card applications are fully online with the startup issuers; transaction sync runs on their APIs.
